Here is a summary of the teaching demonstration transcript in exactly 2-3 concise sentences:

The speaker, Marina Denilevsky, introduces Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) as a framework to improve the accuracy and up-to-dateness of large language models (LLMs), which can generate text with undesirable behavior such as providing unverified answers. She illustrates this issue with an anecdote about her own response to a question, highlighting problems with lacking sources and outdated information. By incorporating a content store through RAG, LLMs can better access reliable sources and provide more accurate responses.
